svg.title: Certifications: six Dicoding Indonesia certificates on a print line
svg.desc: Six certificates from Dicoding Indonesia hang from binder clips on two wires: four front-end courses on the top wire, then back-end and career. 01: JavaScript Programming Basics, covering OOP, functional programming, async, credential NVP741O0WPR0. 02: Front-End Web Development for Beginners, covering DOM manipulation, events, web storage, credential EYX4J9RROZDL. 03: Front-End Web Development Fundamentals, covering Web Components, module bundlers, async JS, credential EYX4J058OZDL. 04: Becoming an Expert Front-End Web Developer, covering PWA, accessibility, automation testing, CI/CD, credential N9ZOY1Y7DPG5. 05: Back-End Fundamentals with JavaScript, covering RESTful APIs, Node.js, Hapi, AWS EC2, credential 2VX349OGVZYQ. 06: Building a Career as a Software Developer, credential 6RPNYN60QZ2M. Every 16 seconds a drafting pencil is drawn along the bottom edges of each row and the sheets swing like pendulums, then hang still.
